newsitem.title: LATVIA: STOCKS STABLE TO HIGHER, UNIBANKA LEADS.
newsitem.headline: STOCKS STABLE TO HIGHER, UNIBANKA LEADS.

text.p: * Total volume on Tuesday was 120,000 lats.
* Unibanka up five santimes to 3.50 lats.
Latvian shares were stable to higher on Tuesday and dealers said that market leader Unibanka looked set to maintain its upward momentum.
Total volume was 120,000 lats as the bourse index crept up 0.63 percent to 396.74.
Unibanka led the way as usual as it added five santimes to 3.50 lats in trade of 55,000 lats.
Its price was being driven partly by investors from neighbouring Estonia, dealers said.
"Unibanka's price compared to Estonian banks is low, while its results are no worse," Arturs Shveds, a dealer with Saules Bank, said.
Unibanka gained five santimes to 3.50 lats on volume of 55,000 lats.
Daugavpils Chain maker was actively traded as institutional investors were seen selling, but the price stayed put at 1.06 lats on turnover of 24,000 lats, dealers said.
"Daugavpils Chain might loose ground slightly in the coming sessions if the amounts offered stay high," Arturs Shveds, a dealer with the Saules Bank said.
On the secondary list, Jekabpils Sugar eased to 67 santimes from 69 santimes in trade of 4,000 lats.
